name: Force of Will
body:
School enchantment (charm); Level bard 1, inquisitor 1, mesmerist 1, paladin 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You guard the mind of the target against spells or effects that would cause them to do things against their morals or normal actions. The target gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against charm, compulsion, and fear effects.

Force of Will, Greater

School enchantment (charm); Level bard 2, inquisitor 2, mesmerist 2, paladin 2, sorcerer/wizard 2
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as force of will except the creature casting such a spell on the target must make a Will save or believe the spell worked and is now under their control. The creature protected by this spell is aware of the commands of the controlling spell and can choose to act as that spell dictates to keep up the ruse.

Force of Will, Mass

School enchantment (charm); Level bard 2, inquisitor 2, mesmerist 2, paladin 2, sorcerer/wizard 2
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as force of will except as noted above.

Force of Will, Mass, Greater

School enchantment (charm); Level bard 4, inquisitor 4, mesmerist 4, paladin 4, sorcerer/wizard 4
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as greater force of will except as noted above.
